title: Social Biases in Knowledge Representations of Wikidata separates Global North from Global South

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Equal Opportunity and Equalized Odds fairness metrics by comparing the True Positive Rates (TPR) and False Positive Rates (FPR) in occupation link prediction tasks for male versus female entities using the AuditLP framework.

Evaluating Equal Opportunity and Equalized Odds fairness metrics by comparing the True Positive Rates (TPR) and False Positive Rates (FPR) in occupation link prediction tasks for young (19-45 years) versus old (60-90 years) entities using the AuditLP framework.

Applying hierarchical spectral clustering on the gender and age occupational bias profiles across 21 different regional knowledge graphs to reveal macro-level socio-economic and cultural disparities (Global North vs. Global South).
